cond_0001.intro: In this Senior Automation QE role, you get to work on automated frameworks for both web, backend mobile platforms of [Company name masked]'s new enterprise electrified fleet application management. We are a quality-first team, and we need your help to ensure we meet the highest standards. We are an innovation first team, and we need your help to ensure we meet the highest standards. Come join us and let's innovate!
cond_0001.responsibilities: Hands on designing and developing test automation framework and test scripts. Refactor and enhance existing automation framework to adapt to the changes in the tech stack for [Company name masked]'s Commercial Software fleet management products in Azure cloud platform. Implement feature automation and create new tooling needed to automate our manual tests. Maintain test framework and ensure flaky tests are identified and fixed efficiently and timely to unblock CI / CD releases. Document and train others on best practices to write efficient, highly maintainable and scalable tests for our front end and backend automated tests. Ensure automated tests are fast, scalable and stable. Integrate test automation with CI / CD release pipeline using Azure Devops.

Minimum Requirements
10+ Years of experience in automation framework design and implementation in web, mobile and backend from scratch.
Proven experience developing comprehensive automation framework in Java.
Experience building automated pipelines (CI / CD) to run automated tests and troubleshooting test failures in Azure Devops pipelines.
Very good knowledge in test methodologies and test design patterns.
Strong in automation design patterns.
BS in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent experience.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to learn new software tools quickly as necessary.
Exceptional communication skills and a collaborative team player.
Interest in staying up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies.
